stem.text: Which flow diagram correctly describes the effect of tar entering the lungs?

A.text: carcinogens come into contact with DNA $\rightarrow$ mutation occurs $\rightarrow$ uncontrolled cell division $\rightarrow$ mass of cells produced

B.text: goblet cells secrete more mucus $\rightarrow$ mucus accumulates causing infection $\rightarrow$ phagocytes attracted by inflammation $\rightarrow$ causes irritation and coughing

C.text: goblet cells secrete more mucus $\rightarrow$ mutation occurs $\rightarrow$ phagocytes attracted by inflammation $\rightarrow$ mass of cells produced

D.text: phagocytes attracted by inflammation $\rightarrow$ mutation occurs $\rightarrow$ uncontrolled cell division $\rightarrow$ elastase destroys the alveolar walls
